svg.title: Unlimited byte window
svg.desc: The window of the byte 0x48 'H': a START beep, the 8 data slots 01001000 and a STOP beep, rendered by the Encoder at 6 bytes/s.
svg.text: One byte, one window: 0x48 'H' = 01001000 at 6 bytes/s
10 slots of 16.667 ms: START, the 8 bits (most significant first; a beep is 1, silence is 0), STOP. Encoder audio at 48000 Hz.
a beep: the level of a 1 now
Like a serial port's 8N1 frame: a start bit, 8 data bits, a stop bit. START and STOP are always tones: they tell the receiver how loud a 1 is.
The receiver decides each data slot against 70 % of the line from the START's level to the STOP's; a window without its START or STOP is dropped.
